dashboard.label: TA-sanpath Overview
dashboard.description: Collects storage-path health from device-mapper-multipath (multipath -l) and iSCSI sessions (iscsiadm -m session): per-multipath active/failed path counts and path state, plus iSCSI session

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-sanpath requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-sanpath", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-sanpath/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("sanpath.multipath_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("sanpath.iscsi_session_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="sanpath:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"active_paths\":\s*(?<n>[0-9]+)" | mvexpand n | stats sum(n) as value
index=main sourcetype="sanpath:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"failed_paths\":\s*(?<n>[0-9]+)" | mvexpand n | stats sum(n) as value

index=main sourcetype="sanpath:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"failed_paths\"") and k != "_count_only" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=active_paths | spath input=o path=failed_paths | table host k active_paths failed_paths
